en.headline: Five-year-old with chronic illness in serious condition after influenza A
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a case of influenza A (H1) complicated by sepsis; the girl, who had received the 2025/26 seasonal vaccine, remains in the paediatric intensive care unit at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said a five-year-old girl with a chronic illness developed fever, productive cough, chills, shivering and shortness of breath from 7 August. She was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital accident and emergency department on 8 August and admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit.

Her respiratory sample tested positive for influenza A virus (H1). Clinical diagnosis is influenza A complicated by sepsis. She remains in hospital in serious condition. Preliminary findings show she had received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccine and had no travel history during the incubation period. Household contacts have so far shown no symptoms.

CHP Controller Dr Edwin Tsui said influenza activity remains high, with the positive detection rate at 9.94 per cent last week. The centre expects activity to stay elevated in the coming weeks and urged high-risk groups to seek medical attention promptly if they develop fever or respiratory symptoms.

zh.headline: 5歲長期病患女童染甲流併發敗血症 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，女童已接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，現於屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情况嚴重。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，一名有長期病患的5歲女童於8月7日起出現發燒、咳嗽帶痰、發冷、顫抖及呼吸急促，8日被帶到屯門醫院急症室，隨即入住兒童深切治療部。
呼吸道樣本證實對甲型流感病毒（H1）呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血症，目前仍然留醫，情况嚴重。初步調查顯示女童曾接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，潛伏期內沒有外遊，家居接觸者暫時沒有病徵。
中心總監徐樂堅醫生指，最新監測顯示流感活躍程度處於高水平，上周陽性比率為9.94%，預料未來數周仍會維持高水平，呼籲高危群組如出現發燒及呼吸道病徵應盡快求醫。
